title: silene cucubalus subsp. vulgaris
intro: Silene cucubalus subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as the red campion, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Silene cucubalus subsp. vulgaris include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
